defect: The fix adds prefixpercent > 0 to the db_stress option-compatibility check for compaction filter / inplace_update_support.
reason: This is a stress-test configuration fix in a test tool (and prefixpercent was already missing from the compaction-filter check before this change), not a product defect introduced here.

defect: The new code passes uint64_t num_prefix_ranges and FLAGS_transaction_sets to RandomTransactionInserter's uint16_t parameters (constructor and Verify), an implicit narrowing that breaks the MSVC /W3 /WX build.
reason: The fix casts exactly these newly added arguments to uint16_t to repair the AppVeyor (Windows) build error, and the narrowing only becomes apparent from the uint16_t signatures in util/transaction_test_util.h.

defect: Duplicate-skipping compares against last_whole_key_str_/last_prefix_str_ that start as empty strings, so an empty whole key or empty prefix added first is never inserted into the bloom filter (false negatives).
reason: The fix adds recorded flags so the first key/prefix is always added, repairing exactly the comparison logic this change introduced.

defect: The fix moves kCharSize from an anonymous namespace in io_tracer.cc into the function to stop the unity-build redefinition clash with block_cache_tracer.cc.
reason: The unity build was already broken by the same kCharSize redefinition (then in io_tracer.h) before this change, which only moved the clashing definition without fixing it.

defect: The fix reworks the Windows Mutex/CondVar to stop using a member unique_lock.
reason: The change is a pure make-format whitespace reformat; the unique_lock design the fix replaces predates it.

defect: InitFromRawData reads index_size_ and num_prefixes_ via GetVarint32 inside assert(), so in release (NDEBUG) builds the reads are compiled out and the index is parsed from garbage.
reason: The fix moves the GetVarint32 side effects out of the asserts in this newly added function, which is what broke db_bench in release builds.

defect: Replacing '= {}' with no initializer makes the static const unordered_maps default-initialized const objects, which clang rejects when the library's default constructor is not user-provided (libstdc++ on Linux).
reason: The fix restores brace initialization ({}) on exactly these two lines to repair the clang compile error under Linux, so the break lies in the lines this change altered.

defect: The fix sets prefix_seek and re-seeks the verification iterator at each prefix boundary for hash-based memtables in db_stress.
reason: The iterator verification loop without re-seek predates this change (it was only wrapped in a random branch), and the fix concerns a stress-test tool.

defect: The fix renames the misspelled parameter huage_page_size to huge_page_size.
reason: A parameter-name typo is a style issue with no behavioral effect.

defect: MaybeAutoRefresh refreshes the iterator after Next()/Prev() even when the iterator has a non-OK status, so DoRefresh rebuilds the DBIter and silently discards the read error.
reason: The fix adds a status().ok() condition to the auto-refresh introduced by this change, which the fix's summary calls a real miss in error propagation.

defect: The fix makes MultiScan Prepare use the dictionary-aware decompressor instead of rep->decompressor when the table uses dictionary compression.
reason: Before this change CreateAndPinBlockInCache already used rep_->decompressor internally, so the change only moved the same non-dictionary decompressor choice to the caller.

defect: The fix clears the sync-point trace and enables/disables processing per iteration in the ThreadStatusSingleCompaction test.
reason: This is a test-only fix of the test's sync-point setup, not a product defect.

defect: The new ReadBlock() uses a local FSReadRequest whose file-system-provided buffer (fs_scratch) is freed when ReadBlock returns while slice_/used_buf_ still point into it, causing a heap use-after-free.
reason: The fix hands the fs buffer out of ReadBlock to the caller, repairing the lifetime bug created when this change moved the read into ReadBlock with its own read_req.

defect: The fix makes KeyNotExistsBeyondOutputLevel use bottommost_level_ for FIFO and kCompactionStyleNone, so tombstones are not falsely dropped in their output-level-0 CompactFiles.
reason: The FIFO/None false-tombstone-removal was pre-existing; this change only added the correct level-style check and the fix extends the same idea to the other styles.

defect: The new PosixEnv::GetThreadID() overrides a virtual without the override keyword while the rest of the class uses override, triggering clang's inconsistent-missing-override error under -Werror.
reason: The fix adds override to exactly this added method to repair the clang build.

defect: The fix adds explicit (int) casts to the 1.2x buffer-growth computations to silence double-to-int conversion warnings.
reason: The build did not use -Werror then and the explicit cast has identical semantics, so this is a warning/style cleanup, not a real defect.

defect: The fix reads persistent-cache files through RandomAccessFileReader to handle unaligned reads with direct I/O.
reason: The direct file_->Read path predates this change, which only replaced asserts with null checks; the fix repairs pre-existing unaligned-read behavior.

defect: The fix moves the footer read retry-on-corruption logic into ReadFooterFromFile so it covers all footer reads.
reason: This change only added ticker counts around the existing footer retry; the missing-retry cases the fix addresses predate it.

defect: Trailing-slash stripping uses wal_dir.substr(size() - 1), which keeps only the last character ('/') instead of dropping it, corrupting wal_dir.
reason: The fix changes the call to substr(0, size() - 1) in exactly the line this change added.

defect: The fix updates the TestWithCompressedBlockCache expectation to count a block cache miss on the failed insert.
reason: In this file the fix is a test-expectation update following a product fix elsewhere (version_set.cc/table reader), so it is a test change.

defect: The fix renames INFO log-level constants in LogBufferTest to InfoLogLevel::INFO_LEVEL.
reason: This is a naming update in a test following a later enum rename, not a defect of this change.

defect: The fix drops the didIO parameter from DummySaveValue to match a later change of the save-value callback signature.
reason: The signature was correct for the interface at the time of this change; the compile break came from a later interface change.

defect: The fix re-enables sync-point processing in the MultiRead test so the partial-read fault injection runs again.
reason: This is a test-only fix restoring test coverage, not a product defect.

defect: The fix relaxes the assert after WriteFile to tolerate a failed write (disk full).
reason: The previous fwrite code already asserted a full write right after reporting a failed write, so asserting on a failed log write predates this change, which only translated it to the Win32 API.

defect: The fix uses unsigned literals (3u, 2u) in ASSERT_EQ against Count() to avoid sign-compare warnings.
reason: The signed/unsigned comparison only became a build error after -Wsign-compare was added to the Makefile three days before the fix, so this is a later warning cleanup in a test.

defect: The new 'bool success = ReadKeyFromWriteBatchEntry(...); assert(success);' leaves success unused in release (NDEBUG) builds, which fails the -Werror build.
reason: The fix marks exactly this newly added variable unused to repair the release-mode build break this change introduced.

defect: The fix passes the next key to FinishCompactionOutputFile when output is cut by ShouldStopBefore (max_compaction_bytes), so range tombstones do not extend file boundaries into the next file.
reason: That call already omitted next_table_min_key before this change, which only added the range_del_out_stats argument.

defect: The fix adds occasional sleeps in the MigrateToDynamicLevelMaxBytesBase test's verification loop to avoid extreme slowness under valgrind.
reason: This is a test-only performance fix, not a product defect.

defect: The new AddFile stats lines print uint64_t values with %lu, a format mismatch on macOS (uint64_t is unsigned long long) that fails the -Werror build.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these newly added %lu formats with PRIu64 to repair the mac build.
